head: goibert_e2.modeling.build_e2_teacher (768-wide task head)

d1_composite.description: E19 + composite union-label rows, rare-pair-weighted sampling

cti.description: d1_composite + L_inv token-state invariance under stop-gradient standalone forwards

composite_construction.pool: train rows with exactly one gold aspect (all ABSA aspects scored) and <=48 tokens
composite_construction.pair_sampling: prob(a,b) proportional to 1/(1+train_pair_frequency(a,b)), a<b, both pools nonempty
composite_construction.row_sampling: A row uniform from pool[a], B row uniform from pool[b]
composite_construction.label: union in raw ABSA code space (0=absent,1=neg,2=neutral,3=pos): A's code at aspect a, B's code at aspect b, 0 elsewhere
composite_construction.assert: tokenize(text).input_ids[1:boundary] == tokenize(A_text, specials=False); tail == tokenize(' '+B_text, specials=False)+[eos]; dropped/retried on failure or truncation

cti_loss.formula: L_inv = mean over composite rows of [mean_t(A content) ||h_t(x)-sg(h_t(A))||^2/D + mean_t(B content) ||h_t(x)-sg(h_t(B))||^2/D]
cti_loss.applies_to: clean forward only (never noisy, never eval)
cti_loss.standalone_B: tokenizer(' '+B_text, add_special_tokens=True) -- exact substring whose tokenization the manifest assert verified equals the composite's B tail, guaranteeing exact content-token alignment
cti_loss.stop_gradient: standalone A/B forwards run under torch.no_grad()

gate: docs/E20_PLAN.md: cti vs d1 rare-pair missed >=5 pts better AND B_present (fork contamination) reduced vs e19 AND F1 not down >0.3
